subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Lock horns
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fight with someone**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**engage in conflict**."
 
• We use the idiom "**lock horns**" when describing a situation where two parties are in conflict with each other.
 
 
• **Example**: *The political parties decided to **lock horns**__ in the next election*.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• The meaning of the given idiom is " संघर्ष में लिप्त होना".
